title: Prompt Re-Verification Credit on Payout Methods Return Charges
content:
After a transfer to one of a host's Payout Methods comes back, the host updates and re-verifies the method's details. A host who does so promptly receives a prompt re-verification credit, taken off the return charge on that return.

## The credit

The credit is counted in calendar days from the date of the return to the method's verification date:

- **USD 5.00** when the details were re-verified on the day of the return or at most 3 days after it;
- **USD 2.50** when they were re-verified more than 3 but at most 10 days after it;
- **nothing** when they were re-verified later, or not since the return.

The return is the latest return on the method. The verification date is the date of the most recent successful verification on the method's record. Once the credit is taken off, the return charge is never below 0.00.

## Days and credit (hypothetical return on 2026-08-04)

| Verification date on the method record | Calendar days after the return | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-08-04 | 0 (same day) | USD 5.00 |
| 2026-08-07 | 3 | USD 5.00 |
| 2026-08-08 | 4 | USD 2.50 |
| 2026-08-14 | 10 | USD 2.50 |
| 2026-08-15 | 11 | Nothing |
| 2026-03-20 (the method's earlier verification, before the return) | Before the return | Nothing: not re-verified since the return |

## Questions hosts ask

- *Does the credit depend on the reason the bank gave?* No. It depends only on how many calendar days after the return the method was re-verified.
- *Is the credit paid to me if the charge is small?* No. It is taken off the charge, and the charge does not go below 0.00.
